title: Tivoli Theatre, Brisbane
geometryBasis: Reconstructed 28.4 m by 50 m envelope northeast of the former Albert Street carriageway between Ann and Adelaide streets. The bearing follows the Albert Street continuation across modern King George Square. The story pin projected onto this line establishes the station of the entrance. Setback and depth are approximate.
sectionBasis: The cleared 1918 street photograph establishes the height relationships, gabled rooftop theatre, tall wall bays, tripartite foyer window, terrace, and projecting cornice. The period description records removable upper side panels and a cornice projecting about six feet.
limitations: The former footprint is reconstructed from the original Albert Street alignment, the story pin, the 1918 photograph and known theatre capacity. The exact lot line, hidden rear and side arrangements, depth and height are estimates.

The cleared 1918 photograph is monochrome. Exterior colors are period-material estimates. The original site has been regraded as King George Square, so historical threshold and sidewalk levels are approximate.
Historical placement covers the documented pre-1927 exterior. The current Fortitude Valley theatre and the surrounding square are outside this model.
